## Definition of Done

- [ ] Code follows the project conventions and was reviewed in this pull request.
- [ ] New code has unit tests, and the whole test suite passes in CI.
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion of the linked issue was verified in staging.
- [ ] No critical or high findings in static analysis or dependency scanning.
- [ ] The API enforces authorization for every role involved (not only the UI).
- [ ] Access to patient data is written to the audit log.
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed: OpenAPI, README or a new ADR.
- [ ] New screens meet WCAG 2.2 AA.
- [ ] Deployed to staging through the pipeline, with no manual steps.
